proposed_facts.reason: Canonical declarations distinguish 52 pointer slots from 26 ordering keys. Initialization clears only slots 0–25, initializes 180, and generates availability-dependent keys. Construction stores bounded character-indexed objects; each listed animation receives frame-zero request/evaluation before its process registration. This factual correction agrees with functionality.md.

Both inline helpers count truthy results over 26 mappings. Fog and camera use the stated conditional recounts and thresholds. Only failed camera playback guards pre-decrement the counter, with an exact-zero scene request and no local clamp or latch. The table-extent and qualifying-invocation corrections agree with the document and canonical source.
